title: result
description: Output of an `execute` or `winget_install` task. The server stores it only for a task of this device that is `Running`, `Unknown`, `Interrupted`, `Timed Out` or `Cancelled` (a cancelled task keeps its status), sets the status from `exit_code` and forwards the output to the panels. It always answers `result_ack` for an integer `task_id`, also when the task does not exist or belongs to another device, so the agent can drop it. A message without an integer `task_id` is ignored.

output.description: Combined output. Agents truncate it to 524 288 characters (the Windows agent appends a note). A result whose output starts with "[REDDEDİLDİ]" and whose `exit_code` is missing, null, -5 or -7 marks the task `Denied`.

exit_code.description: 0.1.13+. 0 = `Completed`, anything else = `Failed`; missing or null = `Completed`. Codes set by the agent itself: -1 time limit (30 min), -2 cancelled, -3 agent error, -4 service stopping, -5 refused (terminal capability or module off; with "[REDDEDİLDİ]" the task is `Denied`), -6 duplicate (never sent), -7 winget is not installed (`winget_install`, with "[REDDEDİLDİ]": `Denied`). For `winget_install` it is winget's exit code as a signed 32-bit integer (an HRESULT); -1978335189 and -1978335135 (already installed) and -1978334967 and -1978334965 (installed, restart pending) also count as `Completed`.

pc_name.description: Sent by the Windows agent (its device ID); ignored, the connection decides.
